metadata.description: Michael Harris's authored Claude Code agent skills.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Authored agent skills: a deploy sequence that lands finished branch work end to end without amending it, a design-patterns dialog that decides code shape with you before writing it, explain-it-to-me briefings that catch a reader up on what a repo actually changed, a markdown spec for docs that render correctly wherever they land, a nasa-coding-standards port of NASA's Power of 10 that bounds the loops, memory and recursion of code handling money or untrusted input and discloses every rule it changed code under, and run-script-handoff conventions for commands you hand back to a human terminal.
